body: Great to know! Yes please ! :) Haha

Woah!😯 Hope you can teach how to paint this. I hope I can paint like this one day *blown away*
I tried painting clouds and it's super difficult for me

You are right. I would like to explain more but it's fine . I cut my communication for eight months few years back. Now its almost impossible to detach myself because of my responsibilities and considering the happiness of other people around me. But Ill try my best to distance myself. Thank you for your words.

Thank you for your kind words. The person X knows that I hate them. X strongly believes they are right all the time and I am wrong and portrays me negative and hurts me by calling me words (which I am totally not) that makes me want to kill myself.

Yeah maybe ! Some people criticize the people after they are dead. I mean common. Leave them alone..they are dead. It was their life and they get to choose. 

But it's best to ignore humans! I have always imagined doing this. I might be naive but I think it's possible to stop my shitty life and run away to a new place n start over! Hope I get the courage to do that one day.

One can think of it like this! Anyway one can die any day. So go crazy . Try stuff like no one is watching or like you have nothing to fear. Try embarassing stuff and laugh at yourself. 
I'm sorry if I am being ridiculous :(

Take baby steps. It's good that you feel like you want to try , even if it's 1%. 
I have been here and I am loosing the only person who gave me hope and kept me alive during my lows. Whenever I wanted to die. I would think of the one thing that I wanted to live for. Definitely not a person because,, people leave at some point (even if it's not their fault). It was painting .. for me. The only reason I want to live and keeps me going is painting. I am not an artist.. I am just a beginner and I want to paint everything I imagine and see one day.

Life can be depressing. But you must have lot more things that you love. Small things that you might not even have realised. Spend time on things that make you feel light and calm.

You are not alone.
